verdict.rationale: Devin's docs explicitly position it to repro and fix bugs, including bugs raised in Slack/Teams threads. Each session gets its own VM with a shell, browser, full repo access and a known-good environment where it can run and test code. Auto-Fix iterates on CI failures and flagged bugs, which covers fix verification. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of root-cause narrowing or debugging workflows (only implied by 'repro and fix'), and independent hands-on corroboration of bug reproduction quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reproduce issues, narrow down root causes, and verify fixes

citations.quote: Tagging Devin on a Slack or Teams thread about a bug you're discussing with coworkers
The cloud session gets its own VM with a shell, browser, and full repo access
fixes flagged bugs, and iterates on CI failures
Configure it once, and every session boots into that known-good state.
